page.overview:
Who is Payload?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Payload was available in 1987 with the Defiant shuttle. ---- Appearance: red hair and mustache; white spacesuit with silver structural supports and red padding on arms and legs

Accessories: white astronaut's helmet with transparent yellow face shield; white Manned Maneuvering Unit backpack and two detachable, white control arms. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/87/payload.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/87/payload.shtml Filecard]

Payload was available in 1989 with the Crusader shuttle. ---- Appearance: red hair and mustache; white spacesuit with yellow structural supports and blue padding on arms and legs; yellow gloves and boots
